youtube_full.title: Written on Our Hearts | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Jeremiah 31:31–34
youtube_full.description:
Written on Our Hearts: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Jeremiah 31:31–34.

Long before Jeremiah, Heavenly Father gave His people good rules called His law. Moses brought them down, written on flat stones.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Wren the Wonderer.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: Written on Our Hearts
1:13 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Wren the Wonderer
1:51 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
3:03 Question time
3:21 Sweet dreams
3:39 More stories, the app and the paperback

📖 Morning by Morning paperback (November book), a story a day that lines up with Come, Follow Me: https://www.amazon.com/Morning-Testament-Kids-Bible-Stories/dp/B0HPTRXL7G

👍 If you enjoyed tonight's story, please like, share, and subscribe for more bedtime scripture stories!
